name: IQL
description: Implicit Q-learning (Kostrikov et al. 2021, CORL commit eeeeef2) offline on the training sessions only, logged from the five built-in strategies and their Dirichlet-noised copies, with a Dirichlet actor over the listed assets and cash. Expectile 0.7, beta 3, gamma 0.99. The checkpoint with the best validation net Sharpe is kept. trials = 5: the default configuration plus a declared grid of 4 (2/4/8 episodes per behaviour, 1000-4000 steps, beta 3/10), compared by mean validation Sharpe over the three ranked tasks and 2 seeds.
